# Yozora Website

- Keep the site static and dependency-free; GitHub Pages serves files from the repository root through `.github/workflows/pages.yml`.
- Preserve responsive layouts, semantic HTML, keyboard accessibility, and reduced-motion support.
- Keep the browser repository link in `index.html` synchronized with the real repository URL before publishing.
- Use `README.md` as the source of truth for local preview and GitHub Pages setup instructions.
